sloka: स ददर्श ततः तस्या वृत्तौ ऊरू सुसंहतौ ।स्तनौ च पीनौ सहितौ सुजातम् चारु च आननम् ॥४-६६-१३॥
transliteration: sa dadarśa tataḥ tasyā vṛttau ūrū susaṁhatau ।stanau ca pīnau sahitau sujātam cāru ca ānanam ॥4-66-13॥

translations.english: 'Then he (Windgod) saw her curved, wellset thighs, her beautiful plump breasts and her lovely pleasing face.
